findings.priority: required correctness fix before executable reuse
findings.finding: The runner ignores run.py/export failure, writes GEN_DONE/.done anyway, and resumes solely from export.csv existence. GA ignores runner status, skips missing rounds, and can select from incomplete observations.
findings.edit: Require successful child and export exits plus expected nonempty result coverage before atomically publishing a success receipt. Resume only from a receipt bound to plan/arm/dataset/wheel hashes. Propagate failure to GA; require all registered rounds or mark the arm incomplete without fitness. Emit partial failure evidence separately and never write a success marker on failure.
findings.validation: Add offline fixtures for failing run, failing export, empty/truncated CSV, stale CSV with changed plan, missing one round, and successful complete receipt; failures must return nonzero and produce no success marker or selectable fitness.

findings.finding: norm() removes every env value equal to any of (0,1.0,'auto'). Python compares integer1 equal to1.0, so BATCH_EST=1, PREFETCH=1 and RERANK_Z=1 are silently discarded even though their actual defaults are0.
findings.edit: Use a per-key defaults mapping (PREFETCH0,BATCH_EST0,FRONTIER1.0,RERANK_Z0,KERNEL'auto') or preserve all explicit env values. Do not use one shared value set for every key.
findings.validation: Independent fixtures must retain the three explicit integer1 settings while removing only each key's actual default; verify distinct genomes stay distinct.

findings.finding: Cache identity samples roughly997 input rows and uses a mutable shared buildtag; two datasets differing only at an unsampled row collide. Variant wheels reuse f21de886 as buildtag without a recorded graph-equivalence proof. A fixed .tmp path can also collide across concurrent writers.
findings.edit: Bind cache keys to the full dataset content/shape/dtype/metric and actual wheel/build-configuration digest (or an explicitly verified shared build identity). Use unique temporary files and atomic publication with per-key synchronization. Record cache hit/load separately from full build time.
findings.validation: Two equal-shaped datasets differing at one previously unsampled row must have different keys; changed wheel/build configuration must not reuse a cache without a verified equivalence receipt; concurrent publishers must not leave a corrupt artifact.

findings.priority: required claim correction; certification required before future gold use
findings.finding: The generator ranks in float32: angular normalization/dots or rounded f32 norms minus2*f32dot, then recomputes distances only for selected IDs. This does not certify exact top100 membership at near ties. No wrong label was established by this review.
findings.edit: Change historical prose to 'brute-force floating-point generated ground truth; exact ordering not independently certified.' Preserve historical artifacts. Before reusing this generator for exact mission gold, add an independent certified/high-precision boundary oracle covering all potentially displaced candidates and ties; merely refining selected100 is insufficient.
findings.validation: Tiny adversarial cancellation/near-tie datasets must match an independent exact or certified oracle on membership and tie semantics; no paid or full benchmark run is needed for this correctness test.

findings.finding: Queue time and 'pending/queued' statements are historical, not current process state. g1-glove is referenced but not committed; plans reference external absolute definitions/wheel/harness paths. The documentation calls all measured work official-runner output despite separate profiler/smoke drivers.
findings.edit: Reframe the PR and section as a dated partial development record plus tooling. Say unrecorded/not completed in this artifact set instead of currently queued. Remove the nonexistent g1-glove plan claim or recover its exact historical artifact with provenance. State external setup prerequisites and separate harness controls, profiler attribution and smoke measurements. Do not launch old plans simply to make the PR complete.
findings.validation: All referenced committed plans must exist; every numerical claim must point to a committed artifact or be marked an unverified historical report; no active-job claim without a current receipt.

findings.finding: The SIFT numbers are local two-round development controls. No matched competitor rerun or complete final confirmation exists in this PR. Official queries have already been inspected; the statement that they serve only as final confirmation is not a fresh-holdout guarantee. A gap above timing spread alone does not establish overfitting; the splits also differ in corpus size.
findings.edit: Retain the measured medians/operating recalls and full CSVs. Remove the unused4.7x/4.8x arithmetic from prose, retain the cross-host/day incomparability. Mark both inspected splits exposed development evidence. Replace the automatic overfitting conclusion with an unresolved generalisation assessment requiring a fresh declared holdout. Date the Docker revision suggestion instead of calling f21de886 current main, and qualify the smaller-grid runtime prediction as unmeasured.
findings.validation: No release claim of first place,2x matched gain, exact fresh confirmation, or completed candidate search may derive from these artifacts.
